shadows.purpose: Subtle red-pink halo around key interactive elements.

motion.purpose: Smooth transition for hovers and state changes.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Pill-shaped crimson primary action CTA button.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background-color: #b01f44; color: #ffffff; padding: 14px 32px; font-family: 'Work Sans', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: 0.05em; border-radius: 9999px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(176, 31, 68, 0.2); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: #910030; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(176, 31, 68, 0.3); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Soft blush secondary button for alternative actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background-color: #ffd2e1; color: #b01f44; padding: 14px 32px; font-family: 'Work Sans', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: 0.05em; border-radius: 9999px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background-color: #ffb9d0; transform: translateY(-1px); }

components.name: Treatment Card
components.description: Elevated white card container with rounded 24px corners and subtle border.
components.html:
Hydrating Facial Therapy

Deep skin hydration with premium organic serum.
components.css: .ds-card { background-color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e0bec1; border-radius: 24px; padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(37, 24, 28, 0.04); transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(37, 24, 28, 0.08); } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; color: #25181c; margin: 0 0 8px 0; } .ds-card-desc { font-family: 'Work Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #594043; margin: 0; line-height: 1.5; }

narrative.overview: Yalia Beauty is designed as a serene digital sanctuary. The interface combines soft rose and blush palettes, warm off-white canvases, and organic rounded contours to create an inviting, high-end wellness environment.
keyCharacteristics: Warm Canvas: Soft off-white and blush backgrounds (#fff8f8, #fdf5f6) replace sterile pure white.
Velvet Primary Accent: Crimson burgundy (#b01f44) used intentionally for primary CTAs.
Tactile Softness: Generous corner radii (24px / 1.5rem on cards, pill shapes on buttons).
Editorial Hierarchy: Serific display headers for warmth paired with legible sans-serif.

rules.name: The 10% Crimson Rule
rules.body: Primary velvet crimson (#b01f44) is reserved for ≤10% of any screen surface.

rules.name: The Off-White Canvas Rule
rules.body: Pure white (#ffffff) is never used as a global page background.

rules.name: The Dual-Type Contrast Rule
rules.body: Titles and section headings above 20px must use Playfair Display.

rules.name: The Tonal Layering Rule
rules.body: Separate nested containers using lighter/darker blush steps rather than harsh black drop shadows.

dos: Do use soft off-white background colors (#fff8f8, #fdf5f6) as default page canvases.
Do pair Playfair Display headings with Work Sans body text for clear visual hierarchy.
Do use pill buttons (rounded-full) for CTAs and 24px (rounded-2xl) radii for content cards.
donts: Don't use pure stark white (#ffffff) as a global page background.
Don't use sharp square corners (0px radius) on cards or primary action buttons.
Don't flood screens with primary crimson (#b01f44); keep accent usage under 10%.
Don't use heavy dark black box-shadows; use subtle rose/espresso tinted shadows instead.
